title: First load starts in the all-customers state and the report shows every customer
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. Your browser has no saved view for this report.
2. Several customers have invoices in the default date range.
steps: 1. Open the Sales By Customer report.
2. Read the Customer filter's collapsed label.
expected: 1. The Customer filter's collapsed label reads "All customers."
2. The report shows every customer matching the other active filters.
3. The all-customers state is an explicit state — while it is active, any customer that appears later (new data) is included automatically.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: The label deliberately does NOT use an "N of M" form (2026-07-21 change) — an "N of M" label at VIU is a build-behind-spec deviation.
